Frequently Asked Questions About Internships in Alabama

How many tech internships are available in Alabama?

There are currently 33+ active tech internship positions available in Alabama. This includes software engineering, data science, product management, and other technical roles across the state.

What companies offer internships in Alabama?

Top companies hiring interns in Alabama include CFD Research Corporation, Amentum, Leidos, Marmon Holdings, Teledyne. These companies offer competitive internship programs with opportunities for full-time conversion.

What cities in Alabama have the most internships?

The cities with the most tech internship opportunities in Alabama include Huntsville, Decatur, Birmingham, H, Hackleburg. These cities are home to major tech companies and startups offering internship programs.

What types of internships are available in Alabama?

Alabama offers a diverse range of tech internships including software engineering, data science, machine learning, product management, UX/UI design, and DevOps roles. Many positions are available for summer, fall, and spring terms.

Are there remote internship options in Alabama?

Yes, many Alabama-based companies offer hybrid or fully remote internship options. You can filter our listings to show remote-friendly positions.
